<><><><><><><><> | Pumpkin Carver <><>
<>You could decorate the orphanage exterior with jack-o'-lanterns if you had seven pumpkins. | Knowledge: Pumpkin Carving

You set up a small table outside the orphanage, in clear view of the street. You're not sure how Bailey will feel about your decorations, but you don't think <<nnpc_he "Bailey">> would take them down. Not if you make enough of a show of putting them up.

You carve seven faces into seven pumpkins, donating the pulp to some culinary-inclined residents, then hang them from around the street-facing part of the orphanage. They look fitting there, hanging from the old building, as if they could be a permanent fixture.
Job done, you carry the table back inside. A small crowd has gathered by the time you return, admiring your handiwork.
